title: Mollie Stone's Rewards — 1% / 2% / 3% rebate on monthly spending
offer_text: Mollie's Rewards is a loyalty program operated by Mollie Stone's Markets. The Program allows members to earn rebates on qualifying purchases and redeem rewards in-store. Members earn rebates based on monthly spending levels with three tiers: Gold Tier: 1% rebate on purchases totaling $0 – $299.99; Platinum Tier: 2% rebate on purchases totaling $300 – $499.99; Diamond Tier: 3% rebate on purchases totaling $500 and above. Once the Diamond Tier ($500+) has been reached, all purchases for that month, going back to the first dollar ($1) will be rewarded at the 3% rate. Twice a year (During the months of January and July) members will receive a store credit voucher, sent in the mail, to the address on file ... Rewards can only be redeemed in the form of store credit voucher for use on in-store purchases. ... Voucher valid at all 9 Mollie Stone's Markets. Members must have a minimum of $10 worth of Mollie's Rewards Dollars in their rewards account to qualify for a Mollie's Rewards credit voucher.
expiry_basis: Standing program; vouchers are issued twice a year (January and July) and each voucher carries its own printed expiry.
requirements: Enroll online BEFORE checkout (free, age 18+)
Enter your phone number at the register for every purchase
Purchases must be made in-store to qualify
Minimum $10 in Rewards Dollars to receive a voucher
The full voucher amount must be used in a single in-store transaction
Any unused amount resets to zero the day before the next voucher is mailed
